title: Wild AG card slider
description: On phones a swipeable row of cards, one 86%-wide card at a time with the next one peeking in, and two round paper arrow buttons (espresso on hover; the unused one faded) above it at the right. From 1024px the same cards stand in a plain grid and the arrows go away.
notes: native scroll-snap: it swipes without JavaScript; the arrows need it
title sits at the left of the arrow row on phones and above the grid from 1024px
columns sets the desktop grid (2, 3 or 4)
